label: Representation empowerment protocol
title: Passive repertoire and accessible control
kind: Frozen protocol and parked experiment registration
summary: The proposed static observer/cadence census has explicit priors and capacity certificates, but its immediate-inclusive primary endpoint makes identity a universal one-bit maximizer. It is parked unrun.
takeaway: The frozen protocol is provenance, not a work queue. A delayed-control replacement needs a new fixed target, cadence and cost contract.
